answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The nectar is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the velvet. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
